name: Original Kvatch gate creature: ordinary club combat and original death script

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = false

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local t=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during original Kvatch creature fight')
 if core.isWorldPaused() then return end
 local nearest=nil;local distance=1e9;local count=0;local dead=0
 for _,actor in ipairs(nearby.actors) do
  if actor.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x03e9cb) then
   count=count+1
   if types.Actor.isDead(actor) then dead=dead+1
   else local d=(actor.position-self.position):length();if d<distance then nearest=actor;distance=d end end
  end
 end
 print('KvatchFight control ready visible='..count..' dead='..dead)
 if dead>=1 then print('KvatchFight original death observed') end
 if nearest then
  local point=camera.getViewTransform():apply(nearest.position+util.vector3(0,0,42))
  local ax=math.atan2(point.x,-point.z);local ay=-math.atan2(point.y,math.sqrt(point.x*point.x+point.z*point.z))
  print(string.format('KvatchFight aim x=%d y=%d distance=%.3f',math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(ax*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(ay*256+.5))),distance))
 end
end}}}}
